name: Tien Kung 3.0
summary:
TienKung 3.0 is a general-purpose humanoid platform from X-Humanoid, the Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center. It combines the center's high-power joint hardware with whole-body control and its embodied-intelligence system to coordinate movement, perception and manipulation.

The manufacturer's application examples include opening doors, reading instruments during inspections, picking and handling objects, and moving through changing surroundings. description.en:
TienKung 3.0 is a general-purpose humanoid platform from X-Humanoid, the Beijing Humanoid Robot Innovation Center. It combines the center's high-power joint hardware with whole-body control and its embodied-intelligence system to coordinate movement, perception and manipulation.

The manufacturer's application examples include opening doors, reading instruments during inspections, picking and handling objects, and moving through changing surroundings. Spoken question answering and guided interaction add a service-facing layer to the physical platform. These examples describe the types of tasks under development and integration; the performance of a particular installation depends on its software, end effectors, environment and task setup.
